original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. Check current handoffs, including #5625 row reentry and #5707 root-prefix lowering, without treating their partial scope as the whole theorem. Prove or falsify that implication with a caller-bound argument; stop at the chosen obligation. Finite tests or root digits do not discharge an all-size statement.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.

actual_scope: Classify exact recovery of arbitrary integer coefficients from a uniform closed error box, their exact sum, and fixed binary-linear checks; construct an attaining decoder and explicit ambiguities.
scope_change_reason: The user requires original work, not an audit. This tests an original changed analytic_recovery interface rather than discharging a retained assumption or extending a predecessor rounded map.
bottleneck_link: Tests whether a sublinear fixed parity sketch could relax the uniform half-unit coefficient precision requirement. A sharp negative result stops that unrestricted recovery route before physical implementation.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified exact classification and constructive decoder; package the result without extending the model.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-input proof. verify.py enumerates every binary row space through dimension six, compares a direct coefficient observation oracle, tests the decoder and boundary/rejection controls, and generates file-bound output.

open_questions.question: Can an actual convolution caller guarantee sparse coefficient-error supports?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A support restriction could escape the unrestricted uniform-error obstruction.
open_questions.first_step: Prove an error-support restriction from a completed numerical supplier, then price exact checks and decoding.
open_questions.blocked_by: A uniform absolute-error estimate does not establish support sparsity.

open_questions.question: Can a fully paid odd-modulus recovery interface lower required precision?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The binary obstruction does not cover larger residue alphabets.
open_questions.first_step: Specify a coefficient domain, exact residue acquisition, returned error and full storage/restoration bill.
open_questions.blocked_by: No odd-modulus caller or cost contract is supplied.
